children.remarks: For consistency's sake, it's recommended you use this method over OriginalGemsCost in most cases.

content.value:
<HarmonyReversePatch(HarmonyReversePatchType.Original)>
<HarmonyPatch(GetType(CardInfo), "BloodCost", MethodType.Getter)>
Public Shared Function OriginalBloodCost(__instance As CardInfo) As Integer

children.summary: ChangeCardCostGetter patches BloodCost so we can change the cost on the fly This reverse patch gives us access to the original method without any changes. This method has a copy of all the code that CardInfo.BloodCost had so it doesn't result in a StackOverflow and freezing the game when called.
